title: loroglossum hircinum var. thuringiacum
intro: Loroglossum hircinum var. thuringiacum, commonly known as the Thuringian beard lily or Thuringian wood lily, is a variety of the Loroglossum hircinum plant, which belongs to the Orchidaceae family. It is a type of terrestrial orchid native to Europe. The health benefits of Loroglossum hircinum var. thuringiacum include its potential to aid in wound healing and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of this plant include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids.
